profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Lowe’s | AI Applications | Architecture & Mentoring | Creator of The Code Conjurer
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer at Lowe’s, building full stack applications and AI features for internal business tools. My work has included workforce management, sales and workforce analytics, and productivity tools, from React interfaces and backend services to data integrations and authentication.

My work also includes application architecture and technical design. I care about how the pieces fit together: the interface, the API, the data, and what happens when software leaves my laptop.

My experience spans React and TypeScript; Kotlin/Java and Spring Boot; Node.js, Express, and Python; and MongoDB, BigQuery, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. I’ve also built integrations between React applications and Looker products.

I began using AI-assisted development at Lowe’s in May 2025, then contributed to internal conversational AI applications before becoming a senior engineer. I now integrate AI features into productivity tools. Coding agents are part of my workflow, alongside code review, debugging, and testing. Moving faster still means understanding what I’m shipping and making it maintainable for the people who work on it next.

I mentor engineers and lead peer coding sessions. I enjoy working through technical problems with other engineers, sharing approaches, and explaining the reasoning behind a decision.

I write The Code Conjurer, where I share practical lessons about programming, AI-assisted engineering, and the decisions around the code: what worked, what broke, and what I learned.

Read my work: https://sabrinadanielle.tech/

I’m also a vocalist and personal essayist. Creativity and clear communication matter to me in every part of my work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop full stack productivity tools and integrate AI features, building on internal conversational AI work begun before promotion.

• Contribute to application architecture and technical design for full stack systems and AI integrations.

• Apply full stack experience across React.js, Kotlin/Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Express, and Python, with MongoDB, BigQuery, MySQL, and PostgreSQL supporting application data and analytics.

• Continue mentoring engineers and leading peer coding sessions, sharing implementation approaches and working through technical problems together.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built full stack workforce-management applications supporting associate scheduling, allocation of working hours, and payroll adjustments.

• Built data analytics tools supporting sales and workforce management.

• Contributed to application architecture and technical design for internal business applications.

• Developed backend functionality using Kotlin/Java and Spring Boot, alongside Node.js, Express, and Python.

• Worked with MongoDB, BigQuery, MySQL, and PostgreSQL across application data and analytics.

• Created integrations between React.js applications and Looker products, including work on complex authentication flows.

• Helped build in-house applications to replace third-party solutions and support internal business workflows.

• Began using AI-assisted development in May 2025 and subsequently contributed to internal conversational AI applications before promotion to Senior Software Engineer.

• Mentored engineers and led peer coding sessions, sharing implementation approaches and solving technical problems collaboratively.

positions.title: Music Teacher
positions.description: I enjoyed my year as a volunteer music teacher. Inspiring young musicians to embrace the beauty in musical diversity and technology.
